AUTH-UI-001.scenario: Check that the sign-in page shows the heading, Email and Password fields, the Forgot password? link and the Sign in button
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Check that the heading 'Sign in' and the text 'Enter your credentials to access the console.' are shown.
Check that the 'Forgot password?' link is shown.
Check that the Email field is an email field and the Password field hides what is typed.
Check that the browser can offer saved username and password for these fields.
AUTH-UI-001.expected: All texts and the link are present, Email is an email-type field, Password is masked, and the fields are marked for username / current password autofill.

AUTH-UI-002.scenario: Verify that submitting the sign-in form never puts the email or password into the page address
AUTH-UI-002.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type an unknown email and a password.
Click Sign in and wait for the response message.
Look at the address bar.
AUTH-UI-002.expected: The address bar does not contain the password or a 'password=' parameter.

AUTH-UI-010.scenario: Check that Email and Password must both be filled before signing in
AUTH-UI-010.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Fill the Email and Password fields as per the data set (leave one or both empty).
Click Sign in.
Read the messages under Email and Password.
AUTH-UI-010.test_data: Variants: both empty; email 'qa.user@example.com' with password empty; email empty with password 'Secret@123'; email of spaces only with password 'Secret@123'
AUTH-UI-010.expected: An empty Email shows 'Enter your email' (spaces only shows an email error); an empty Password shows 'Enter your password'; a filled field shows no message; and no sign-in request is sent.

AUTH-UI-011.scenario: Check that a badly formatted email shows the format message and is not sent
AUTH-UI-011.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the invalid email and the password 'Secret@123'.
Click Sign in.
Read the message under Email.
AUTH-UI-011.expected: 'That does not look like an email address' is shown under Email and no sign-in request is sent.

AUTH-UI-020.scenario: Check that a wrong password shows an error and does not sign the user in
AUTH-UI-020.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the sign-in page with location allowed. Only one wrong attempt is made per run so the account is not locked.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the admin email and a wrong password.
Click Sign in.
Read the message under the form.
AUTH-UI-020.test_data: Email: admin account email / Password: Wrong@Pass1
AUTH-UI-020.expected: 'Invalid email or password.' is shown, the code (OTP) step does not open and the user stays on the sign-in page.

AUTH-UI-021.scenario: Verify that an unknown email gets the same message as a wrong password so accounts cannot be discovered
AUTH-UI-021.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type an email that has no account and any password.
Click Sign in.
Read the message under the form.
AUTH-UI-021.expected: The message is exactly 'Invalid email or password.' (no 'user not found' style message).

AUTH-UI-022.scenario: Verify that SQL code typed in Email and Password never signs in and never shows a database error
AUTH-UI-022.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the SQL text in both Email and Password.
Click Sign in.
Check the page address and the page text.
AUTH-UI-022.expected: The user stays on the sign-in page, the code (OTP) step does not open, and no text like 'SQL', 'syntax error' or 'exception' appears.

AUTH-UI-023.scenario: Verify that script code typed in the sign-in fields is never run by the browser
AUTH-UI-023.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the script text in both Email and Password.
Click Sign in.
Watch for any pop-up alert box.

AUTH-UI-030.scenario: Check that when location access is blocked a clear notice is shown and Sign in stays disabled
AUTH-UI-030.preconditions: Browser is opened with location permission NOT granted.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Wait for the location notice to appear.
Type an email and password.
Read the notice and check the Sign in button.
AUTH-UI-030.expected: The notice 'Location access is required to sign in' is shown with a 'Try again' link, and the Sign in button is disabled.

AUTH-UI-031.scenario: Check that when location access is allowed no notice is shown and Sign in becomes enabled
AUTH-UI-031.preconditions: Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Wait for the Sign in button to become enabled.
Check for a location notice.
AUTH-UI-031.expected: The Sign in button becomes enabled and no location notice is shown.

AUTH-UI-040.scenario: Verify that correct credentials open the 'Enter the code' step with a masked email and six code boxes
AUTH-UI-040.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. Location access is allowed in the browser.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the admin email and correct password.
Click Sign in.
Wait for the 'Enter the code' screen.
Read the text and count the code boxes.
AUTH-UI-040.test_data: Email: admin account email / Password: admin password
AUTH-UI-040.expected: The text 'We sent a 6-digit code to …' is shown, the email is partly hidden with dots (the full email is not shown), and there are 6 code boxes.

AUTH-UI-041.scenario: Check that 'Verify and sign in' stays disabled until all six digits are entered
AUTH-UI-041.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User has entered correct credentials and is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
With 0 digits entered, check the Verify and sign in button.
Enter digits one box at a time (1, 2, 3, 4, 5), checking the button after each.
Enter the sixth digit (6) and check the button again.
AUTH-UI-041.expected: The button is disabled with 0 to 5 digits and becomes enabled once all 6 digits are entered.

AUTH-UI-042.scenario: Check that letters, symbols and spaces typed into the code boxes are ignored
AUTH-UI-042.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Click the first code box.
Type a letter, a symbol and a space.
Check the content of the box.
AUTH-UI-042.expected: The first code box stays empty.

AUTH-UI-043.scenario: Verify that pasting a 6-digit code into the first box fills all six boxes
AUTH-UI-043.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Paste the whole 6-digit code into the first box.
Read the six boxes from left to right.
AUTH-UI-043.expected: The digits are spread across the boxes, reading 1 2 3 4 5 6.

AUTH-UI-044.scenario: Check that a wrong code shows an error, clears the boxes and does not sign the user in
AUTH-UI-044.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Enter the code 000000.
Click Verify and sign in.
Read the message under the code boxes and check the boxes and page address.
AUTH-UI-044.expected: An error message is shown under the code boxes, all boxes are cleared, and the user stays on the sign-in page.

AUTH-UI-045.scenario: Check that 'Send a new code' starts disabled with a seconds countdown
AUTH-UI-045.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Read the label of the resend button.
Check whether the resend button can be clicked.
AUTH-UI-045.expected: The button reads 'Send a new code in Ns' (N = seconds left) and is disabled during the countdown.

AUTH-UI-046.sub_module: OTP step – Use a different account
AUTH-UI-046.scenario: Check that 'Use a different account' takes the user back to the sign-in form
AUTH-UI-046.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Click 'Use a different account'.
AUTH-UI-046.expected: The sign-in form with the Email field is shown again and the code step is gone.

AUTH-UI-047.scenario: Check that refreshing the page on the code step returns to the sign-in form without a half-finished session
AUTH-UI-047.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Refresh the browser page.
Wait for the sign-in form to appear.
Check whether the tab holds any session.
AUTH-UI-047.expected: The sign-in form is shown again and no session is stored in the tab.

AUTH-UI-048.scenario: Verify that after entering only the password, opening the Dashboard address directly still requires sign-in
AUTH-UI-048.preconditions: A valid admin account exists. User has entered correct credentials and is on the 'Enter the code' step.
steps: Reach the 'Enter the code' step.
Without entering the code, type the /dashboard address in the browser and open it.
AUTH-UI-048.expected: The user is redirected to the sign-in page; the password alone does not give access.

AUTH-UI-050.scenario: Verify that email, password and code sign the user in to the dashboard with a tab-only session that expires within an hour
AUTH-UI-050.preconditions: A valid admin account exists and its sign-in code can be read from email. Location access is allowed.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Type the admin email and password and click Sign in.
Enter the 6-digit code sent by email and click Verify and sign in.
Wait for the console to load and check the side menu.
Check where the session is stored and when it expires.
AUTH-UI-050.test_data: Email: admin account email / Password: admin password / Code: from the sign-in email
AUTH-UI-050.expected: The Dashboard menu is shown, the session token is kept only in this tab (not in long-term browser storage), and it expires within 60 minutes (about 30 minutes expected).

AUTH-UI-051.scenario: Check that a signed-out user who opens the Beneficiaries page is sent to sign-in and returned to Beneficiaries afterwards
AUTH-UI-051.preconditions: User is signed out. A valid admin account exists. Location access is allowed.
steps: Type the /beneficiaries address in the browser and open it.
Check that the sign-in page opens and its address remembers the target page.
Sign in with email, password and the emailed code.
AUTH-UI-051.expected: The sign-in address contains 'next=%2Fbeneficiaries' and after sign-in the user lands on the Beneficiaries page.

AUTH-UI-052.scenario: Verify that a return address pointing to another website is ignored after sign-in
AUTH-UI-052.preconditions: User is signed out. A valid admin account exists. Location access is allowed.
steps: Open the sign-in page with a 'next' return address pointing to an outside website.
Sign in with email, password and the emailed code.
Check which website the browser is on.
AUTH-UI-052.expected: The browser stays on the escrow console website and is never sent to evil.example.com.

AUTH-UI-060.scenario: Verify that every console page sends a signed-out visitor to the sign-in page
steps: Type the console page address in the browser and open it.
Check the page that opens.
AUTH-UI-060.expected: The user is redirected to the sign-in page.

AUTH-UI-061.scenario: Verify that a new browser tab without the tab session is not signed in, even with saved cookies and local storage
AUTH-UI-061.preconditions: Admin has signed in once and the browser's saved cookies and local storage are available.
steps: Open a new browser window that has only the saved cookies and local storage (no tab session).
Open the /dashboard address.
AUTH-UI-061.expected: The user is redirected to the sign-in page.

AUTH-UI-062.scenario: Verify that a fake session token planted in the browser does not open the console
AUTH-UI-062.preconditions: User is signed out. A fake session is placed in the browser tab before the page loads.
steps: Place a fake session token (valid until 2099) in the browser tab storage.
Open the /beneficiaries address.
Check the page address and whether any list data is shown.
AUTH-UI-062.test_data: Variants: random token 'abc.def.ghi'; unsigned token (algorithm 'none', user 'admin'); empty token
AUTH-UI-062.expected: The user is sent to the sign-in page or no beneficiary data is shown.

AUTH-UI-063.scenario: Verify that the access token is kept only in the tab session and not in cookies or long-term browser storage
steps: Sign in as admin.
Read the access token from the tab session.
Check the browser cookies for the token.
Check the browser local storage for the token.
AUTH-UI-063.expected: A token is present in the tab session, and it does not appear in cookies or local storage.

AUTH-UI-064.scenario: Verify that any session-like cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite
steps: Sign in as admin.
List the browser cookies whose names suggest a session (session, token, auth, jwt, sid).
Check the security flags of each such cookie.
AUTH-UI-064.expected: Each session-like cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite Lax or Strict. If there is no such cookie, the check is skipped (token is kept in the tab session instead).

AUTH-UI-070.scenario: Check that 'Forgot password?' opens the reset page with the email field, Send reset link and Back to sign in
AUTH-UI-070.preconditions: User is on the sign-in page.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Click 'Forgot password?'.
Check the content of the 'Forgot your password?' page.
AUTH-UI-070.expected: The page shows 'Enter the email linked to your account', a 'Send reset link' button and a 'Back to sign in' link.

AUTH-UI-071.scenario: Check that the reset form checks the email before sending
AUTH-UI-071.preconditions: User is on the Forgot password page.
steps: Open the sign-in page and click 'Forgot password?'.
Type the email as per the data set.
Click Send reset link.
Read the message under Email.
AUTH-UI-071.expected: Empty shows 'Enter your email'; 'abc' and 'abc@' show 'That does not look like an email address'.

AUTH-UI-072.scenario: Verify that an unknown email gets the same neutral 'If an account exists for …' answer so accounts cannot be discovered
AUTH-UI-072.preconditions: User is on the Forgot password page.
steps: Open the sign-in page and click 'Forgot password?'.
Type an email that has no account.
Click Send reset link.
Wait for the 'Check your email' screen and read the message.
AUTH-UI-072.expected: 'Check your email' is shown with the text 'If an account exists for …', and no 'not found' message appears.
